title: Migrant adaptation correlates 的跨情境 robustness
statement: 辨識哪些social/contextual correlates在不同migrant groups、receiving societies與adaptation outcomes中穩定，並區分correlation與causal support。
known_result: 2025 Nature Communications preregistered meta-analysis整合1114 primary studies與5066 effects，發現stressors與social resources是較穩定correlates，但論文本身也指出因果仍需longitudinal/experimental研究。
first_task: 重現meta-analysis的一個公開summary-level moderator calculation；做leave-one-context-out和small-study sensitivity。
validation_limits: meta-analytic association仍非因果；不得將群體結果套到單一移民。
completion_criterion: 後續longitudinal/independent meta evidence能重現核心correlates並縮小context moderators。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查。社會科學結果高度依賴population、platform、time period與identification assumptions；每輪需重查版本與反證。
screening_queries: migrant adaptation meta analysis social contextual 2025 2026

sources.title: A Meta-Analysis of Social and Contextual Correlates of Migrant Adaptation to Living in Receiving Societies
